repository.description: AstroGit-OS is a reference declarative architecture for the configuration, maintenance, and operational lineage of optomechanical instrumentation in next-gen astronomical observatories.
repository.name: AstroGit-OS

milestones.title: Milestone #1 — Read-only demonstrator against a representative operational subsystem
milestones.description:
### Project Status & Roadmap

**Current Status:** Draft Development
**Due Date:** Early Q4 2026

---

### Scope & Deliverables

* **Declarative System & Domain Modeling**  
Formalize the hierarchical digital representation for site entities states, encapsulating physical domains (Dome, Mount, Optics, Instrumentation), logical governance structures, and astronomical observation relationships. 

* **Canonical State Schema & Taxonomy**  
Define declarative schema specifications (YAML/JSON) and unique identifier (UID) standards for hardware components, operational variables, subsystems states, and Site compound macro-state (e.g., Operational Preparation, Standby, Observation, Maintenance, Safe State).

* **Operational Baseline Ingestion**  
Establish the initial version-controlled operational baseline (To-Be) within local Git repositories, mapping initial hardware assets, parameters, and system boundaries.

* **Non-Intrusive Telemetry Connectors**  
Deploy passive, read-only connectors and state extraction agents to read live operational metadata from existing Telescope Control Systems (TCS) and control system layers without interfering with real-time execution.

milestones.title: Milestone #2 — Automated drift detection & state reconciliation engine
milestones.description:
### Project Status & Roadmap

**Current Status:** Planned
**Due Date:** Q1 2027

---

### Scope & Deliverables

- Ingest real-time telemetry from passive edge agents to continuously evaluate the physical state (*As-Is*).
- Implement the core reconciliation engine comparing live operational telemetry against declarative state configurations (*To-Be* in YAML/JSON schemas).
- Develop automated drift detection alerting mechanisms for out-of-tolerance hardware/subsystem configurations (e.g., optomechanical alignment deviations, filter assembly parameters).
- Provide a CLI and API reporting interface for system drift visualization.

milestones.title: Milestone #3 — Pull-Request changes governance & SHA-256 scientific traceability
milestones.description:
### Project Status & Roadmap

**Current Status:** Planned
**Due Date:** Late Q2 2027

---

### Scope & Deliverables

- Implement CI/CD pipelines to validate, test, and approve engineering state changes via Pull Requests (GitOps workflow).
- Integrate automated pre-deployment schema validation for hardware/instrument reconfigurations.
- Implement the SHA-256 cryptographic binding engine to link scientific Observation Blocks (OBs) with immutable operational hardware state fingerprints.
- Expose cryptographic proof verification tools for open science metadata reproducibility.

milestones.title: Milestone #4 — Consolidation and Continuity of AstroGit-OS
milestones.description:
### Project Status & Roadmap

**Current Status:** Planned
**Due Date:** Early Q4 2027

---

### Deliverables & Continuity

Upon completion of the 9-month execution period, the project will deliver a functional technology demonstrator, full source code, technical documentation, operational models, and traceability artifacts under open licenses (MIT and CC BY 4.0)—providing a reusable and extensible asset for the community.

Future adoption, institutional scaling, and industrial technology transfer remain prospective next steps based on demonstration results, requiring no additional scope or funding under the current project.

issues.body: ### **Nodes:** {SUMMIT, REGIONAL BASE, GLOBAL NODE, CLOUD} **Policy Concepts:** {Redundancy, Distribution, Resilience, Traceability} --- ### SPANISH DEEP WHITEPAPER COPY ORIGEN -> 2 GOBERNANZA INSTRUMENTAL MEDIANTE CÓDIGO SECCIÓN -> 2.4 Política de Operación Distribuida AstroGit-OS permite que la gobernanza del estado operacional continúe de forma local cuando la conectividad entre nodos se encuentra degradada o interrumpida. Las modificaciones realizadas durante una condición de desconexión permanecen asociadas al repositorio local y son posteriormente sometidas a sincronización, detección de divergencias y reconciliación una vez restablecida la conectividad. La distribución no implica independencia semántica entre los nodos, sino capacidad de mantener representaciones locales del estado operacional y preservar la continuidad del historial de cambios bajo condiciones de conectividad intermitente. - **Redundancia** Múltiples réplicas sincronizables del estado operacional, preservando copias independientes del historial y reduciendo la dependencia de un único repositorio. - **Distribución** Repositorios/nodos desplegados en Cumbre, Base Regional, Nodo Internacional y Cloud, permitiendo mantener y sincronizar el estado operacional entre distintos dominios físicos. - **Resiliencia** Capacidad de continuar operando localmente ante la pérdida de conectividad o falla de un nodo, mediante sincronización posterior de la infraestructura distribuida. - **Trazabilidad** Reconstrucción histórica de estado, configuración e intervenciones mediante el historial versionado de cambios para la evolución operacional de cada componente.

comments.body: ### Subsystems Modeling --- > [!CAUTION] > **Draft Proposal — Pending Technical Review** > This breakdown — in scope, depth, and structural detail — serves as a draft baseline. It requires technical validation and is open for review and feedback from the team. --- #### Dome - **Structure & Motion:** Arch/Shutter Doors, Azimuth Drive System, Wind Screens / Baffles, Vent Louvers. - **Thermal & Environment:** Building Air Conditioning / Slit Chilling, Air Circulation Flaps, Dome Thermal Mass Management. - **Service & Safety:** Crane & Hoist Infrastructure, Mirror Handling & Coating Access Platforms, Enclosure Safety Interlock System (SIS). --- #### Mount - **Kinematics & Drives:** Altitude/Pitch Drives, Azimuth/Yaw Drives, Cable Wraps & Drag Chains. - **Hydrostatic & Bearing System:** Hydrostatic Bearing System (HBS) / Oil Pad Lines, Structural Thermal/Strain Sensing. - **Rotator / Adaptor Assemblies:** Nasmyth / Cassegrain / Prime Focus Rotators, Cable Rotators. - **Mount Auxiliary & Safety:** Mount Locking Pins / Stow Brakes, Seismic Restraint Systems, Emergency Stop Grid. --- #### Optics - **Primary Mirror Assembly (M1):** Mirror Cell, Active Optics Support (Pneumatic/Axial/Lateral Actuators), M1 Thermal Control, Segment Edge Sensors & Positioning Actuators (si es segmentado). - **Secondary Mirror Assembly (M2):** M2 Cell, M2 Hexapod (5/6 DOF Positioner), M2 Adaptive/Active Surface Unit. - **Tertiary & Auxiliary Optics (M3, M4, M5...):** M3 Deployable/Tower Mechanism, M4/M5 AO Tip-Tilt / Flat Units, Stray Light Baffles & Covers, Mirror Dust Covers. - **Calibration & LGS Launch (OPT-CAL):** Laser Guide Star Launch Telescopes (LGLT), Telescope Calibration Units (Flat-field / Arc lamps). --- ####Instruments - **Focal Plane & Beam Distribution:** Field Pick-off / Dichroic Beamsplitters, Atmospheric Dispersion Corrector (ADC), Calibration & Guiding Unit (CGU / Technical WFS). - **Adaptive Optics Modules (AO):** Natural/Laser Wavefront Sensors (WFS), Deformable Mirrors (DM), Real-Time Controller Hardware Interface. - **Cryo-Vacuum & Environment:** Cryostat Pressure Vessel, Vacuum Pumping System, Cryo-coolers (Pulse Tube / Gifford-McMahon), Thermal Stabilization Controllers. - **Detector & Optomechanics Systems:** Science Detector Arrays (CCD / CMOS / IR FPA), Detector Readout Electronics (DRE), Filter Wheels, Dispersive Optics (Gratings/Prisms), Shutter Mechanisms.
